notes.title: Minor Visual Update
notes.notes: This is a small update which adds a few option for a VCR Filter for the player inside of the video settings.

notes.title: PATCH 1.0
notes.notes:
This patch includes:
-Added Difficulty option for players which including checkpoint system on some of the larger maps
-Updated the "Invite Only" to be "Friends Only" in the multiplayer search menu.
-Spectating should more consistently keep track of who is alive/dead
-The one skin Stealer in a room will no longer corner camp the player
-Will now be able to invite player through steam when selected "friends only" option for hosting
-Added More Precision for adjusting player volume
-Adjusted a few props around level 5
-Added more indicators that a door is locked
-adjusted some volumes of objects 
-Dropped Almond water will now fall to the ground
-Slightly increased rate of almond water spawning
-Changed description of Achievements
-Adjusted some collisions in "Level 2"
-Shortened "The Backrooms: Descent" Title Sequence and removed interaction dot when in sequence
